activation_rule: Neighbors remain dormant until the no-control core passes every broad positive activation minimum and the selected controlled/base candidate passes all non-neighborhood development gates.
materialization_rule: Merge each override into strategy_parameters without changing any other byte-level input; then preregister and run each neighbor independently before reading its result.

neighbors.hypothesis: A two-day compression estimator reacts sooner without changing the slow baseline.
A four-day compression estimator rejects brief false compressions.
A stricter compression prerequisite trades only deeper squeezes.
A looser compression prerequisite tests whether the edge is broad rather than threshold-local.
A lower release threshold admits moderate impulses.
A higher release threshold trades only clear volatility releases.
An earlier continuation transition tests a wider definition of broad price discovery.
A later continuation transition requires stronger cross-sectional confirmation.

selection_prohibition: Do not add, remove, or recenter neighbors after any neighborhood result is observed.
